description: Post a message to a Slack channel or DM as YouSpot, optionally as a reply in a thread. Only channels the bot has been invited to work; use list_slack_channels to find ids. Write it the way you would write anything else: '## ' headings, '- ' bullets, **bold**, and [label](url) links all render, and Slack's own *bold* and <url|label> do too. Confirm with the user before posting anywhere others can see it.

team_id.description: The workspace, when the user has more than one.

thread_ts.description: Reply in this thread instead of the channel.
